column1: # One row per clause, and the thing that has actually been observed making it deny.
# WITNESS    a session in eval/corpus replayed through the REAL dispatcher, where the
#            first fire must name the clause the session declares. That naming rule is
#            what makes a session evidence about its own row: the table is ordered and
#            first-match-wins, so a denial from any other clause would otherwise pass.
#            Being extended by the occasion algebra is NOT a witness and is not counted
#            here. The algebra says a fingerprint COULD match something; it says nothing
#            about the clause denying. Keel formerly accepted it as one of three
#            dispositions, which is a weaker bar than Ward (a session for all twelve
#            rows and the fail-closed preflight) or Makoto (every gate fired through its
#            now holds Keel to the same bar.
# A live waiver is the one other disposition: it cannot be driven because `_applicable`
# skips it, and it carries research and an expiry, so a lapse reddens with no edit.
# 23 of 24 driven; 1 parked by a live waiver; none held by nothing.
